item.title: ‘Splinter Cell: Deathwatch’ starring Liev Schreiber renewed for Season 2 at Netflix
item.description: Netflix renewed Tom Clancy’s Splinter Cell: Deathwatch for a second season. Based on the “Tom Clancy’s Splinter Cell” video game franchise, the adult animated series stars Liev Schreiber as Sam Fisher, with Kirby Howell-Baptiste as Zinnia Mckenna.
